detail.longDescription: Tenuo is a task-scoped authz primitive for agentic work. We are an open protocol and an open source implementation at github.com/tenuo-ai/tenuo We created a fork of OWASP finbot with Tenuo wired in and red-teamed it with promptfoo. We went from 50 successful attacks to 0 with Tenuo. The promptfoo attacks were able to fool the model, but the deterministic guardrails Tenuo provides stopped it from acting on the poisoned instructions.
